title: 1ST ADDENDUM TO THE BIDDING DOCUMENT FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, CONFIGURATION AND MAINTENANCE OF E-SEALS FOR ELECTRONIC CARGO TRACKING SYSTEM (ECTS) - Uganda Revenue Authority

# 1ST ADDENDUM TO THE BIDDING DOCUMENT FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, CONFIGURATION AND MAINTENANCE OF E-SEALS FOR ELECTRONIC CARGO TRACKING SYSTEM (ECTS)
Reference is made to the advert that appeared on 3 rd, 4 th, 5 th and 7 th February 2026 in the Daily Monitor, News Vision and East African newspapers for Supply, Installation, Configuration and Maintenance of E-seals For Electronic Cargo Tracking System (ECTS).
This is to inform all interested bidders that the bid closing date has been extended from Friday 6 th March 2026 to Friday 20 th March 2026 as per the revised procurement schedule below;
The New Planned procurement schedule is as follows;
Activity
Publish bid notice
3 rd February 2026
Pre-bid meeting
11 th February 2026 at 10:00am
Bid closing date
20 th March 2026 at 10:00am
Bid opening date
20 th March 2026 at 10:30am
Evaluation process
23 rd March 2026 to 3 rd April 2026
Display and communication of shortlisted bidders
13 th to 24 th April 2026
Date of Contract Signing
After Solicitor General’s Clearance
Any queries should be addressed to;
The Assistant Commissioner, Procurement & Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority Headquarters,
Plot M193/M194, Nakawa Industrial Area,
13 th Floor URA Tower,
P. O. Box 7279, Kampala.
Telephone: 256 (0) 417- 442155/6/7/8/9
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at www.ura.go.ug and at www.ppda.go.ug
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
